title: Screen P112 tetrad coefficient fusion under relaxed rank ceilings
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This source-bound P112 follow-up composes tetrad coefficient fusion through the selected centre consumer. For each of the 14 tetrads, the same four product values emit both the fused port update and the source-side dirty correction:
`M E^T = U K`, `J = (C^T M) E^T`, and `S^T(d + U K x) - Jx = S^T(d + Kx)`. This establishes exact coefficient-level co-delivery for arbitrary dirty baseline (d), without claiming a native schedule or free scalar work.

Binding the eight centre outputs to the selected native frames gives the unique minimum slot map `[7,5,4,6,3,1,0,2]`; all 56 augmented terms have support-pair rank one. The complete bounded screen checks 784 valid completions and 18,816 elementary shears. Every tested shear preserves the rank-one factorization. Minimum centre support is 76 coefficients, versus 88 for standard-row complements and 92 for the original completion.

At the sensitivity charge of one rank-one unit per centre coefficient, the best tested local cost is 132, above the 112-copy control. Its ideal two-unpaid complex profile `{1:324, 32:166}` has local mass 5,636 and ceiling `κ = 0.0134440084459`, below the 0.0137876681081 baseline. These are conditional ceilings, not physical invoices or admitted suppliers. The dirty-state lifetime, native term schedule, scalar tariff, bit-side endpoint contract and complete joint invoice remain open. The selected κ remains `0.001672660197076918`; no frontier change or κ improvement is claimed. This changes the consumer endpoint and does not contradict the original P112 COPY112 floor.

## Task and overlap

Task card `coverage-law-change`, priority revision 6; scope refined to source-bound co-delivery and a finite completion/shear sensitivity screen. The package is based on `9a56309846c262238de04138d14d8bc32ec83d77`; exact source blobs and hashes are in `research/p112-centre-co-delivery/SOURCES.json`. The scope change follows the preceding consumer audit: it had identified the source-side correction but had not shown how its values could share the tetrad products.

This extends [PR #3566](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3566)'s selected-port binding and [PR #3567](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3567)'s tetrad-local rank screen through the selected centre consumer; it also retains the dirty-state correction audit from this PR's earlier work. The cached overlap scan covered 394 PRs and 2,319 discussions as of 2026-10-18 03:15 UTC, but refresh failed, so it is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

Reproduction, from the repository root with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-centre-co-delivery --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-centre-co-delivery
```

The registered replay checks all 14 co-delivery identities, native-label complements, all 40,320 slot assignments, 784 completions, 18,816 shears, support-rank profiles and the conditional complex ceiling. It does not certify a native COPY schedule, physical scalar tariff, supplier admission, complete joint invoice, selected cold replay or a multiplication theorem.

## Credit

The P112 root geometry and local decoder retain the attribution in `research/p112-tetrad-local-decoder/`. The selected-port bijection comes from PR #3566; the native centre-role/frame binding retains `research/selected-centre-native-lift/` and its predecessors. This follow-up adds the co-delivery factorization and the bounded completion/shear census. Prepared by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can one augmented tetrad term family be implemented as a chronological native COPY program on arbitrary dirty ports and centre channels? Bind one tetrad through its source forms, outputs, adapters, dirty inputs, scratch lifetimes and restoration, and price every scalar operation.
2. Can both selected suppliers justify two unpaid coordinates under that complete endpoint contract? Replay the exact full-call coverage identity on both sides, including co-delivered centre outputs and restoration. The bit-side premise and joint endpoint remain unadmitted.
